title: Chapter 252 Master Qiao Appears
content:
Chapter 252 Master Qiao Appears

Seeing Shi Liantian like this, Lu Xue smiled again, "Mr. Shi, I don't think you want to disappoint my mother, right?"

As soon as these words came out, Shi Liantian was shocked.

Thinking of Yan Lingyun's horror, Shi Liantian felt a little cold in his heart, and he nodded quickly and said, "That's right, that's right, since I have the ability to reach the sky, I naturally have to show it."

"Let the people of the world take a good look at what a real pill is!"

Speaking of this, Shi Liantian couldn't help but feel a little excited.

Alchemy?

I have indeed not practiced for a long time.

But that doesn't mean he is not as good as before.

A glimmer of light flashed in Shi Liantian's eyes, and he was full of energy.

Seeing his master's changes, Yuanyuan also showed a smile.

"Master, you can do it!"

Seeing the master and apprentice cheering each other, Lu Xue laughed.

"By the way, I haven't known you yet?"

Lu Xue suddenly said at Yuanyuan.

Upon hearing this, Yuanyuan said directly: "Miss Lu, my name is Yuanyuan, just call my name."

Round.

Lu Xue nodded slightly, "My name is Lu Xue, you can call whatever you want."

"But by the way, your name,"

Before Lu Xue finished speaking, Shi Liantian, who was standing beside him, interrupted, "I got it, how about it, okay."

"Uh, Yuanyuan, does it mean?"

I heard Shi Liantian smile and said, "Yuanyuan, just like the elixir, it's so good."

Lu Xue's mouth twitched slightly.

Haha, it's really good.

It can be seen that Shi Liantian really likes to refine alchemy.

But why are you practicing Gu again now?

What Shi Liantian said was that refining alchemy was too simple, but obviously, it was definitely not that simple.

at the same time.

In the deserted city.

"This is the deserted city."

Tan Songci stood at the entrance of the deserted city and flipped his hands to send Bai Lushuang and others out of the bookstore.

A flash of light.

Bai Lushuang and others immediately appeared in the deserted city.

"this!!"

For a moment, a series of amazement came from the mouths of the crowd.

Everyone suddenly looked at the gorgeous giant city in front of them with incredible expressions, each of which was filled with a noble and mysterious atmosphere.

Is this really the Wood Fairy Realm?

This question arose in everyone's heart.

Even in the fairyland, they have never seen such a place before.

Living here is simply paradise.

On the streets of Huangcheng, passers-by occasionally threw a look of contempt at Bai Lushuang and others.

Haha, another group of local buns from the countryside.

Feeling the strange eyes around him, Tan Songci quickly coughed lightly and pulled everyone back to his thoughts.

"Okay, don't watch this. The competition should have begun soon. Let's go."

Hearing Tan Songci's words, everyone hurriedly said yes.

Led by a patrolling guard in the city, everyone soon arrived in a square outside the deserted city.

At this moment, it was already crowded with people and full of places.

If it weren't for the law of forbidden air, many practitioners would have looked down at the air.

"Ahem, can you please give me a seat? I am the tutor of Tiandi Academy. Today I came to Huangcheng to watch the alchemist's alchemist's alchemist's alchemist's today."

Looking at the dense crowd in front of him, Tan Songci wiped his forehead, thinking of using his old face to change his vision to a better place.

Although with your own cultivation, you can feel the situation on the competition stage even if you don’t watch it, who would refuse to see it with your own eyes?

Tan Songci's voice was not loud, but many people still heard it.

"Damn, where did you come from the old thing? You even pretend to be a college tutor?"

"Look at what I'm like, I'm also the tutor of the academy. I also said I'm the dean of the academy."

"Old pussy, where is your face? I'll ask you what is your face?"

Constant insults came towards Tan Songci from all directions.

Feeling the power of the trolls around him, even though Tan Songci had a good temper, he couldn't help but turn black.

Nowadays, no one believes the truth outside?

Bai Lushuang and others were extremely angry when they heard these insults and clenched their fists.

"Teacher, these people are really too much!"

"Teacher, the students can't stand it anymore, the students are going to take action!"

"Teacher Tan, these people are really vulgar, and the students despise them."

Seeing that several of their own students were about to roll up their sleeves and rush towards those people, Tan Songci quickly waved his hand, and a gentle force immediately stopped everyone.

"Okay, don't bother with them, let's change the place."

Tan Songci took a deep breath and his emotions were suppressed.

"But,,"

The students wanted to say something, but when they looked at Tan Songci, they shook their heads, they gave up.

Seeing Tan Songci and others leaving in disappointment, the people who were sneering at each other.

These days, people really have it.

Even the tutor of Tiandi Academy dared to pretend.

In a blink of an eye, he came to the other end of the square, and Tan Songci's emotions returned to calm.

"We came from afar this time, so we naturally have to abide by the regulations here."

"No noise and quarrels are allowed."

Hearing this, these students who came out of Tiandi Academy immediately bowed their heads slightly.

They still have to listen to the rules of this city.

After all, if you think about it, you can know that this city is absolutely extraordinary. Its strength is probably not weaker than some of the forces in the Immortal Realm.

Bai Lushuang and others thought so in their hearts.

They were in the bookstore in Tan Songci's hands before, so they did not see the scene that happened in the deserted city before, and the terrifying feeling that made people feel cold in their hearts.

Tan Songci is still feeling scared of such a terrifying giant city.

Within such a terrifying force, Tan Songci really doesn't want to take risks and provoke the rules here.

The consequences must be unimaginable.

In this way, the whole square was vast and the people were waiting for several hours.

Finally, there was a movement in the center of the square.

"Tiandi Academy, Jordanyang, Master Qiao appears!"

A loud shout.

I saw an ordinary old man walking towards the stage with a slightly heavy expression under the leadership of several people from the deserted city.

"That's, it's Master Qiao!!"

"Damn, it's really Master Qiao!"

Master Qiao!

In an instant, the atmosphere in the entire square was completely ignited.

Everyone started to cheer.

Isn't this the purpose of their coming?

Today, it is enough for them to brag about Master Qiao's alchemy style for a lifetime.

"It's the master!"

Tan Songci and others also saw Jordanyang on the stage and quickly waved their hands and shouted.

On the stage, Jordan Yang's expression moved slightly, as if he felt something, and quickly turned his head to look at a corner of the square.

But because there are too many people, there is nothing to see except for the crowd.

Jordanyang had no feeling about the admiration of these people for themselves.

"Oh, today I don't know whether it's a blessing or a disaster."

Jordan Yang shook his head slightly, feeling very complicated.

"Mr. Qiao, don't be nervous, just do your best."

On the side, Wan Feng stood beside him and greeted him with a smile.

Hearing this, Jordanyang barely squeezed out a smile and said slowly, "I understand."
